title: O Lord, Be Gracious to Me

questions.question: Blessed is the one who considers the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:1 (ESV): "Blessed is the one who considers the poor! In the day of trouble the Lord delivers him;"

questions.question: The Lord protects him and keeps him alive; he is called blessed in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:2 (ESV): "The Lord protects him and keeps him alive; he is called blessed in the land;"

questions.question: The Lord sustains him on his sickbed; in his illness you restore him to full what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:3 (ESV): "...in his illness you restore him to full health."

questions.question: As for me, I said, "O Lord, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against whom?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:4 (ESV): "...heal me, for I have sinned against you!"

questions.question: My enemies say of me in malice, "When will he die, and his name what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:5 (ESV): "My enemies say of me in malice, 'When will he die, and his name perish?'"

questions.question: And when one comes to see me, he utters what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:6 (ESV): "And when one comes to see me, he utters empty words,"

questions.question: Even my close friend in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has lifted his what against me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:9 (ESV): "Even my close friend in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has lifted his heel against me."

questions.question: But you, O Lord, be gracious to me, and raise me up, that I may do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:10 (ESV): "...and raise me up, that I may repay them!"

questions.question: By this I know that you delight in me: my enemy will not do what over me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:11 (ESV): "...my enemy will not shout in triumph over me."

questions.question: But you have upheld me because of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:12 (ESV): "But you have upheld me because of my integrity,"

questions.question: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! Amen and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:13 (ESV): "Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! Amen and Amen."

questions.question: While his heart gathers iniquity, when he goes out, he tells it to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:6 (ESV): "...when he goes out, he tells it abroad."

questions.question: All who hate me whisper together about me; they imagine what for me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 41:7 (ESV): "...they imagine the worst for me."

questions.question: They say, "A deadly thing is poured out on him; he will not what again?"
This Psalm concludes which book of the Psalms?
questions.explanation: Psalm 41 is the final psalm of Book One of the Psalms (Psalms 1-41).

key_verse_text: Blessed is the one who considers the poor! In the day of trouble the Lord delivers him;
